company_info.company_name: PTE Solar and Electrical Pty Ltd
company_info.company_description: "Choosing solar can be a difficult and stressful process. PTE Solar makes your decisions easy and painless. Our job is to design the system that suits you best and take you through the whole journey effortlessly. Our goal and intentions are to strive for excellence, honesty and professionalism, whilst maintaining the highest level of customer satisfaction and service – a truly unique solar experience.We at PTE Solar take pride in our design, installation and work and ensure we meet all industry standards and regulations, and adhere to all safety requirements. Along with this, we offer 10 years workmanship warranty.The PTE Difference:6+ years industry experienceCertified, trained and qualified to design systems, along with licenced electrical background. Installs are conducted in-house by PTE (No sub-contractors used & no pushy sales tactics).Post-installation monitoring of all systems once installed (our job does not end at the install).We only use high quality products to take care of your property and integrity of the system (these are small things like excellent quality cable, solar conduits, roof polyurethane and dektites, high quality mounting system and panels/inverters)All items quoted are technologically advanced as compared to the normal products being offered in the market.We charge a fair and competitive market price for a select-grade install and a sustainable business (lowest price is not always the best) and can design systems tailored to your budget.Use of products that have Australian warranties and have been tried & tested.We are SAA certified."

reviews.review_description: Very professional and easy process..should have done it years ago

Buying solar and a battery is a big deal! It's basically the third biggest purchase you make after a house and a car. From my first chats with Patrick I knew PTE solar were the people for the job. He knows his stuff and and it really put me at ease.Patrick and his wife came up with a competitive quote and kept me well informed in the run up to the build. My battery had to be installed quite far from my meter box due to safety regulations, and they did a very neat job with cabling and conduit which I really appreciated.Patrick and his very polite PTE team seemed like they'd been working together for some time and I was very impressed with their work ethic over the course of the day.The system looks to be performing very well, and I've not used any grid power in the week that it's been installed.Keep up the good work and I'll be recommending PTE solar to friends and family.

For anyone looking into solar — especially with battery systems these days — it can be quite overwhelming. There are so many options, technical details, and decisions to make. I really appreciate how Patrick took the time to walk me through everything, explaining what system would best suit my needs and the pros and cons of different setups.He helped me understand the differences between single-phase and three-phase systems, full and partial backup options, and where each dollar is going. I adjusted the system size several times, asked for multiple quotes, and even switched brands during the process — and Patrick remained incredibly patient, responsive, and transparent throughout. He’s a straight shooter who sets clear expectations, which I really value.The installation itself was very smooth and well-organised. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and completed the installation by early afternoon. They also communicated clearly about the placement of the equipment, walked me through the steps, and helped set up the monitoring system afterward.Overall, I’m very happy with both the system and the service. The installation quality is excellent, and the pricing is very competitive. I highly recommend Patrick and the PTE Solar team to anyone considering a solar and battery setup.

Patrick is an outstanding professional who arrived promptly for the solar quotation and patiently answered all my questions—no matter how numerous. His level of patience and professionalism is unmatched, and his deep knowledge ensures he recommends the best solar system for your needs, even if other options might be more profitable for his business.On installation day, Patrick demonstrated exceptional problem-solving skills. He and his team of highly skilled installers worked diligently from 7am to 6pm. Despite the challenges presented by my Newington house roof, strata regulations, and the need to remove both hot water panels and old solar panels, Patrick and his team handled everything seamlessly. The workmanship and materials used were of the highest quality.Patrick also took the time to upload the inverter app onto my phone and taught me how to monitor my usage and solar output. He even followed up the next day to ensure everything was functioning perfectly. I’m very pleased I chose PTE Solar.

Quoting process went smoothly with PTE and they got back quickly in response to questions we had (on issues like asbestos in the meter box) and clearly answered them. The sales/payment process was clear as well. Before installation, The layout plan was adjusted so that the shadow from our chimney made less impact on performance which has been a wise move. Patrick advised that we might need some roof tiles in case of breakage which I did obtain. On the day, installation went well but we did require some more tiles (that Patrick was able to source). Overall, installation went smoothly.We were shown the inverter and Patrick got the SolarEdge app going for us. It has been helpful having the App and we are now more effectively managing our electricity use (having the aircon heater on during the day).

PTE Solar installed a 5kW PV system for me in late 2023. PTE gave me several options on panels and inverters, and we ended up going with 12 x Trina S+ panels and a SolarEdge inverter.  The install was punctual and very professionally done.  Patrick walked me through setting up the app and showed me how he monitors the health of  all the systems that he installs. I would definitely recommend PTE to others looking for an install.
A great experience!The installation was punctual and efficient.They ticked all the boxes.Highly recommended!

Team were very professional and worked neatly.Team was on aite at 7.30am and were finished by 1pm. No mess was left behind, like we did not know they were there.Patrick set up the app and explained how everything works.Would recommend highly

All good.Good pricing, quality products, neat installation, good follow up and customer service.And it's family run, which I really appreciated. You deal with Patrick for the quote, Patrick comes for the installation, Patrick calls you after to check if the system runs fine.Highly recommended.
Sales/quote process was very satisfactory.The installation went well. All installers were always polite,tidy and punctual.The customer service was exceptional. Everything was explained very well.

Patrick and Emily were a terrific team in designing and delivering our Solar install. This is a business where the Owner maintains all oversight of the installation process and signs-off on everything. There is no sub-contracting involved and they are happy to give you time to understand all the detail and make your own decision. I was impressed with the attention to detail and the workmanship of the install. Competitive pricing and they were very good at maximising the design of the system for our small terrace roof which showed they were keen on both smaller and large jobs. Looking forward to having them back if we decide add a battery in the future. Highly recommended.

The whole process with PTE Solar was seamless. There is a lot seemingly contradictory info out there about the various solar plans, panels, inverters etc. Patrick was very patient with my endless questions about the process.The installation itself was very professional, clean, tidy, efficient - they got the job done and they did it well.

In a very competitive and confusing market, we have obtained 4 quotations for the top solar systems available in the Sydney market (panels and inverters).  PTE solar was the most competitive price.The main reason for selecting PTE solar was not the competitive price, but it was the company reviews which indicated not even a single case of dissatisfaction.The job was done by Patrick and his team. Every step of the work was very organized, and Patrick ensures that nothing goes wrong during the entire process.PTE Solar and electrical Pty Ltd is a small company. The work is done by the principal, so all risks associated with any subcontracting work is eliminated.If you are after excellent quality and guaranteed results, you should consider. PTÈ Solar.  Highly recommended..

My solar system was installed yesterday. From start to finish my dealings with Patrick and Emily was professional and efficient. They were always accommodating with my questions and change requests. Their communication and arrangement for each step of the job was always thorough and prompt. Patrick and his team was polite, arrived on time, got straight to work and completed the installation without any fuss. It was completed as quoted and explained. Their clean up after the job can only be described as impeccable. I am now waiting for Ausgrid to upgrade my meter. I couldn't be happier with my choice of PTE Solar and Electrical for my solar system and would highly recommend them to any prospective customers.

We're very pleased with the system installed by PTE Solar. Patrick gave thoughtful consideration to our situation and provided great advice on panel layout and inverter requirements when visiting to quote, and all steps proceeded in a timely manner. There have been no problems with the system.

The whole process was as smooth as it can be, Emily sent over the initial solar design in no time then answered my numerous emails with questions about the difference between differenct options, the panels and the layout. Then a installation date was quickly confirmed after we agreed to go ahead.On the day of the installation, Patrick and the team arrived early then jumped right into it, Patrick also answered a few questions I had on the day, then gave me a full run down of the system after confirming its functioning as intended, finishing off by helping me setting upthe sungrow app and also gave me a full run through about it's features.All in all, a wonderful experience, 10/10 :D

PTE were very prompt in quoting and very clear in their communication and options provided. When it came to the installation the team was punctual, clear in their communication and kept us abreast of what was going on. The system has been running flawlessly since we have had it installed and would highly recommend PTE to anyone looking for a solar installation.

Patrick and team at PTE were excellent.Quote process was easy - recommended a good system and answered all questions.Installation went very smoothly. Team was professional, clean and fast. Work done to a high standard.Have answered all question sive had post-installation quickly.Overall, very happy and would recommend.

My experience with PTE Solar & Electrical from start to completion has been very positive. It was great talking to a installer and not a salesperson. Patrick gave me a very competitive quote for a quality installation.  He gave me professional advice when needed and answered every question I asked. Emily was also very efficient and helpful from the office side of things. It was great that Patrick was the person I dealt with from start to finnish. I'm very happy with the installation so far and would definitely be happy to use PTE Solar in the future.
From the very first contact, to sweeping up before they left Patrick and his team were friendly, efficient and supremely professional.I'd recommend them to everyone.
Patrick and the team from PTE Solar & Electrical exceeded our expectations. Great communication, punctual, quality product and smooth installation.
Patrick and Emily made the whole process very easy and smooth. Patrick and the team arrived on time and we’re very efficient. I would definitely recommend PTE Solar and Electrical.

Patrick and Emily were great to work with and the entire process was straightforward. They were always happy to help and all emails and phone calls were promptly replied.Installation started on time and staff were friendly. Patrick and team were very professional and questions about the installation or system were answered by Patrick. Patrick was committed to making sure everything was done to the highest standard. He even stayed back to clean up and ensure the site was left completely clean.I would recommend talking to Patrick and Emily if you are looking to install Solar.

We used the solarquotes website for our research and quotes. We chose PTE for its excellent reviews and lack of negative comments. The whole process from quotes, information sharing and decision making was seamless.Installation was efficient, timely, and neat. The installation team was polite, punctual and completed the job in the estimated timeframe. The grid connection and approval processes were all handled by PTE. The solar system looks great and the consumption panel monitoring has already changed the way we use our powered devices.We highly recommend Emily & Patrick of PTE Solar & Electrical for any residential solar installation.

From start to finish Patrick and Emily were very efficient, polite and punctual, answering my many questions in a timely manner. The installation was very professional, especially as they had to remove an old non-functioning system first. They even sourced the replacement tiles for me, going above and beyond what was required. Everything was left clean and tidy. They helped organise the grid connection, got the ap working on my phone and monitored the system to make sure all was working correctly. All in all I would highly recommend PTE Solar to anyone thinking of installing a solar system.

Patrick and Emily were fantastic to deal with throughout he whole process. Emily dealt with my numerous emails and questions regarding the different system options, without fuss & reasonably promptly.On the day of installation, Patrick and his team turned up at the promised time. Installation was very professional despite some challenges due to our difficult roofline as well as our roof having Spanish terracotta rooftiles. Due to some of these challenges it also meant that the install took a bit longer than anticipated however Patrick and his team continued with the task finally finishing about an hour after sunset on a Friday night. Patrick even returned the following day, on his day off, to recheck the system and ensure everything was working well.Highly recommend PTE Solar.

Excellent quoting service.Efficient, informative and pleasantInstallation looks great, no problems. Patrick made certain the app was working and organised grid connection.I’ll definitely will ask Patrick to install battery later in the year.I’m very happy with the system

PTE get 10/10 for installation and service. Patrick was great to deal with and the job was done without a problem. Very happy with how the whole installation is working. Patricks work is very neat and tidy. Being a tradesman myself for over 40 years i was very impressed with how the whole job was handled from start to finish. I would highly recommend Patrick to anyone who wants to put solar on their roof.

The sales and quoting process was flawless and hassle free. There can be a lot of sellers and installers in Australia that use inferior product so after a great deal of research we considered PTE Solar the best in a confusing market. The installation went smoothly and on-time. The team of installers were considerate, polite and efficient and answered all our questions.  PTE told us when they would install and it was done on the date and on time. They organised the grid connection on our behalf and installed a powerwall back up. Well priced and reputable. I would certainly recommend this company to my friends looking for a solar system that comes with great service and team knowledge.

The P in PTE may be for Patrick, though it may also be for Polite, Prompt, Punctual, or Professional. Selecting a Solar configuration and installer is a lengthy and stressful exercise. Having the PTE team assist you with your Solar decision and installation makes a tough decision far less stressful. The highly efficient PTE installation team arrived on time and completed the work with no fuss or hassle. Very impressive. Well done PTE.

This is a small family owned business that, to all outward appearances, runs like a fine watch. Patrick selects the details of your recommended system(s) and takes you through the trade offs. Emily chases up all approvals and fields questions. Patrick runs the crews on-site. All members of the crew work for PTE. In our case, Patrick and the crew turned up on time, went straight to work, and were finished by late afternoon. Easy person seemed to know what they were doing. The site was left totally clean.Emily guided me through the sign up process and scheduled my installation. My install date was only two weeks away and PTE met it as scheduled. Patrick answered all my questions on the day and showed me how to use the Solar Edge app. A few days later when I had a couple of questions I got a call from Patrick.At no time was there ever any sales pressure. Nor did I ever find that a product had been chosen on its brand name but the particular item was subpar. Overall PTE did a great job and I can recommend them unreservedly.

I am so pleased that our trusted neighbours recommended Patrick and his team.  Patrick was professional, responsive and efficient.  He imparted his expert knowledge without a sales pitch, and I genuinely felt he cared about our home and needs.  His electrical experience enabled him to lay those cables through walls, cavities, and through onto the roof.  It was amazing!  He organised our government rebate, set up the SolarEdge connection, and showed me how to use the SolarEdge app.  Within seconds I could see our solar panels' production on my phone.  What a legend!  We are very happy with the service and expertise, and we have no hesitation in recommending Patrick and his team.  No fuss.  No Mess.  Priceless!
The whole process was seem less and effortless.We had agreed on a quote and within a few days they were on my roof installing the solar panels. Which is amazing

Emily and Pat are a very efficient family run business. They genuinely care about their customers and it shows!Emily and Pat communicate very well with each other so there is no miscommunication as you may get with larger companies.The prices are very competitive and they are very thorough with their work! If you are considering getting solar, you should reach out to them because they are really good at what they do!
PTE have it all - friendly professionalism, no sales 'spin', owner does the installation, excellent customer relations.  I cannot fault PTE and highly recommend them.  Thanks Emily and Patrick.

PTE Solar listened and provided clear advice about system options to suit my requirements without sales hype.Installation occurred as schedule and to a quality standard - the team was polite and courteous.Customer service was responsive throughout.

I could not recommend PTE Solar and Electrical more highly.Every step of the process was perfect.I had done some research but still had plenty of questions and Emily was very patient and helpful with my requests and changing options. I had issues with partial shading on our north facing roof. Unlike some other companies, PTE would not quote to use this roof space even though I wanted to maximise my panels.Patrick and his team were excellent on the day of installation and everything went smoothly and perfectly. Our roof is steep which was certainly challenging and some installers had rejected my enquiries on this basis. The installation was finished in one day - a fantastic looking result and the site left completely clean.Highly, highly recommend.

Patrick came out to the house, did a site inspection, presented to me his best recommendations vis a vie panels, optimisers, inverters and process for installation. He was sensitive to my needs and flexible in panel placement.Installation was professional and reflected quality workmanship.I can highly recommend PTE Solar and Electrical to anyone considering switching to solar power.

A really good and competent installer for my Solar system, booked them after hearing good things from acquaintances and did not disappointment. Would recommend to anyone looking at getting solar.On time, courteous and and great customer service both for sales and installation.

Very happy with all parts of the process from quoting to installation and post installation service. Very pleased with the quality of the panels and inverter/optimisers and the advice provided, although the other quoters were also good in this regard.PTE were the only installation company to actually climb on the roof and measure as opposed to just using satellite images. As a result we have an extra two panels that the others wouldn't consider.Would recommend them and use again if required
The entire process was excellent.  From quoting to design and then implementation.  Everything was handled with the highest level of professionalism.

PTE was excellent through every step of the process. Even though we had done the research, we were relatively ignorant, so we had many naive questions, all of which were answered patiently. Their knowledge and attitude were markedly superior to the others who quoted. This made them the obvious choice. I don't think I even compared prices in the end, as I was confident I'd get what I paid for from PTE.We had issues at our end that delayed us finalising the quote. We also made several changes over time, all of which were patiently accommodated.On-site, the install team were polite and professional. They tidied up after themselves. All issues were resolved with our wishes in mind.Patrick and Emily were a delight to deal with

Sales Quoting process was extremely efficient and provided with much detail.Installation was all of the above, polite, neat and punctual.After sales support brilliant, all paperwork sent quickly to assist with connection to grid.Would highly recommend .

The sales process was straightforward conducted over email and a site visit by Patrick.The installation started on time, took most of the day and was tidy with no complications. Only one broken roof tile!  Patrick’s staff appeared to be new to the job but he was on top of them!  The grid connection occurred a couple of days after installation as Patrick indicated I had smart meter already.

Patrick and Emily at PTE came highly recommended to us and I would highly recommend them to others.Emily is a delight to work with. She responds promptly to emails and phone calls and was so patient with the numerous questions I asked. Her quotes are well set out and easy to understand and she updated them promptly as we made changes. We had very recently changed power providers and could not provide some of the information requested but Emily sorted it all out and handled all correspondence with the energy company incredibly quickly.At all times the PTE staff were polite and courteous. Any questions about the installation or the system itself were answered by Patrick who was the one doing the installation. It was comforting to know that the owner was the one actually installing the system as he was committed to getting it right. Patrick continued to monitor our system and rang to check in the following week to make sure all was running smoothly. I have also contacted Patrick after the installation and his customer service has been outstanding! Unlike many companies who do not want to know you once you have paid your last installment.We are so glad we chose to support this incredibly honest, and trustworthy family business.
Quick and efficient service from quoting process to installation.Happy to recommend PTE Solar for residential solar installations.

Emily and Patrick provided excellent customer service front the start.  I did the recommended research so came back with several questions.  I also consulted with my neighbours and came back with further questions, which were all answered to my satisfaction.  The contracting phase was easy.  Patrick came out to do a detailed site inspection and we discussed some further logistics to ensure the solar was as efficient as possible.  We also discussed electric vehicle charging options.  The installation team were on time and professional.  Emily and Patrick have remained on standby (even on weekends) to answer any follow up questions.

PTE Solar were a pleasure to deal with from start to finish. I sourced many quotes, both through Solar Quotes and others I arranged  myself, and PTE were by far the best to deal with and the quickest to respond. Right from the start we had a feeling of confidence , honesty and trust.Patrick and Emily run a great business, they are both courteous, intelligent, articulate and reply to emails and communication promptly. They had an extensive range of products available and didn't pressure us into specific brands like other companies tried to.As well as competitive pricing on quality components, the important consideration for us was that Patrick who installs the system is also the owner, so he has a vested interest in ensuring the whole installation process runs smoothly and is completed to a quality level, which it was. As well, he is in the best position to answer technical questions regarding installation and components. Patrick was also very accessible and obliging in answering my questions. I would also prefer to support a smaller family business who are big on personalised service and a quality outcome , without pushy salespeople trying to sell inferior products at inflated prices.On the installation day, Patrick was fantastic, keeping me in touch with arrival times, as we had to work around the wet weather. He was punctual, tidy and happy to explain the whole process, including setting up the app for me and linking the system to my phone, so I could see my system working immediately. The whole process ran incredibly smoothly and efficiently. His team worked exceptionally well together.Emily is amazing too, her emails and quotes are well set out and easy to understand and she responds promptly to emails and phone calls. She certainly knows the products she is selling and is exceptionally competent in answering questions and queries. She handled all the correspondence with our energy provider from start to finish so we did not have to do anything.It was very refreshing to find such quality people in Emily and Patrick, and in the end, it was the easiest decision we have made in 40 years of home ownership. We would have no hesitation whatsoever in recommending PTE to anyone, as they are a company in whom you can place absolute confidence and trust.Thank you again Patrick and Emily !

PTE were professional at all times.Despite my many questions Emily and Patrick were always calm, polite answered with patience.They were happy to give quotes on several different possible systems and brands.The installation was efficient and timely.I have recommended PTE to others.

We recently installed a solar system.  The whole process went really well.  We had 3 quotes organised through Solar Quotes and one ourselves.  We went with Patrick Tartak from PTE Solar.  Patrick contacted us promptly and came to our home to talk us through the quote and process.  He was very open and informative, with what we could expect and the options available. He had a range of products available, and his prices were very competitive.  He was a local small businessman who had been in electrical work and then solar install for several years.  His reviews were very positive and he lived up to those.  Arranging the install was very smooth and was only a couple of weeks.  On the install day Patrick and his team turned up at the arranged time.  He was very professional, and informative and his work was really neat and tidy. The whole process with the electricity company was taken care of.  Patrick also arranged a Level 2 electrician to quickly fix a problem with our meter box ,  and he also followed up to check how the system was running.  We could not be happier.  What was potentially a very stressful situation was all taken care of.  I would highly recommend PTE Solar and Patrick

I changed my mind enough times to generate 50 emails between myself and Emily - never once did she let on how annoying that could be. Every time nothing was too hard, re-sending panel layouts not a problem, changing panel colours, changing panel numbers, changing inverters easy as.Once settled, the timelines were exactly as specified, with only unscheduled rain interrupting our install (2 stories up on terracotta tiles is not where you want to be when it is wet). Patrick was needlessly apologetic about him and his 2 guys getting off the roof and was keen to ensure I was ok (I was).Emily promptly rebooked a time that suited me, and worked around my pool trades.Patrick turned up exactly on time both times (7.30am) and got to work with little fuss. All his team were in full safety gear and Patrick did everything he could too keep everything he did very tidy (even on a site where our pool trades have dumped rubbish everywhere).Patrick treated my home like his own and ensured that his work was as invisible as possible, chasing wall cavities and concealing conduit as much as possible. Very happy with the care and effort.Would happily recommend.

We had around 8 quotes and whilst PTE wasn’t the cheapest, they also didn’t put down other companies or products, were upfront, honest and not pushy. They honoured their quote unlike other installers who quoted but then jacked up prices, or who tried to give installation dates months down the line.Overall though I just had that feeling of trust with these guys from get go. Customer service was outstanding and even now, post installation they’re still top notch.We ended up going for a high end system - Enphase with REC panels. Unfortunately COVID and the war has impacted supply chains and we paid more for a 6kW system today than my parents did 18 months ago for an 8kW equivalent system with another Solar-quotes installer. Just the way unfortunately.The installation date itself was excellent. Rain threatened but no rain so it was able to proceed. This is the third system in the family and very seamless. Post installation everything was patiently explained and PTE arranged the connection and contacting the utility. They monitor the system for performance post installation.Fully cleaned up after themselves. Wouldn’t even have known any work was done except for the app showing were generating energy!Would highly recommend PTE. If I could give 6 stars then I would!

I decided to do my bit for the environment and also to try and be a bit more aware of the amount of electricity we consume.I really knew nothing about how it all worked but my son had heard of a few reputable solar installers that he had heard of through friends in the electricial trade.He brought Patrick from PTE Solar around one afternoon and I was immediately impressed with the way he offered advice without trying to sell any particular brand or being biased in any way.His quote was very reasonable and competitive so made the decision to go with PTE solar.Well I have to say big thumbs up for Patrick and his very polite and smiling team.I felt very comfortable inviting them into my home and the neatness of all the wiring and layout. Very unobtrusive and all tidied up immaculately.I absolutely would not hesitate to recommend Patrick and PTE solar and electrical

My mother made the decision recently to go ahead with a solar system combined with a battery, partly because the steadily rising cost of power and partly because she wanted to do her bit ion moving towards carbon neutral based on ethics.Having read many reviews and talked to other people who had made the move towards storing the suns energy to discharge in peake usage times, usually when the sun isn’t at its strongest position, she decided on PTE solar and Energy.I was so impressed with the professionalism and the genuinely unbiased advice Patrick offered combined with seeing the quality of workmanship of Patrick and his team( i honestly wouldn’t have believed he could have installed a 10.6KW system, an inverter, the tesla powerwall 2 as well as the Tesla Gateway 2 in one day) but he did and took away all of the considerable amount of packaging used in safely transporting the delicate panels, so my wife and i decided to go ahead and put in exactly the same system. We got several quotes and PTE solar was extremely competitive so it was a very easy decision to go ahead and engage PTE solar to put in a complete solar panel, inverter and Tesla battery having already seen what high quality service i was committing to.So patrick Finished our system and had us off grid within a day! incredible really.We are trying not to obsess over continually watching the realtime view on the very advanced Tesla software that allows yo to observe in real time the way the Tesla gateway manages the job of feeding your house, recharging and discharging the battery whilst using the grid as little as can be manage based on your household demand.Great work!Can’t recommend Patrick and PTE solar highly enough.

PTE Solar was the first installer to get back to me after I signed up with SolarQuotes. They gave me a comprehensive quote based on my needs, with a month-by-month estimate of solar generation from systems I was interested in. There were no pushy sale tactics, rather when I decided on the system, they promptly installed it just a few weeks out from when I first engaged them.On the day, Patrick was very punctual, tidy and helped organise the grid connection seamlessly. The system was up and running later that day and he followed up on the Enphase app himself to ensure everything was operating as it should. I can see why others have rated PTE so highly and I have no reservation doing the same.

PTE Solar were a pleasure to deal with - from quotation to installation. Emily and Patrick run a courteous and efficient business. Calls and emails were responded to promptly. The system cost was very reasonable and Patrick and his team cut no corners when it came to the construction, which was easily completed within the day. We have great confidence that our new solar installation will deliver many benefits well into the future.

I sought system quotes from several providers. PTE took the time to understand my objectives and proposed two solutions that addressed my environmental constraints (trees!) and gave me options on price/quality trade-offs. I had many questions as I worked to identify the company and solution I wanted to contract: PTE was responsive, objective, and informative - no sales pressure, none. I was able to take my time and make the buying decision when I was ready.On installation day, PTE turned up at the agreed time and all team members were courteous, clean, and professional. The site was spotless on departure. I'm very happy. Bring on the sun!

Patrick and his crew are every consumer's dream.They provide genuine honest advice and education about Solar before even discussing the quote.They then ran us through the design which was best suited to optimize our self-consumption.I studied and researched the products I wanted and they happily took it on board as they were premium products PTE were already installing frequently.The installation was conducted as if it were their own home, carefully handling the panels, making sure the position and alignment of the panels on the roof were millimeter perfect, minimizing the use of intimidating cable conduit and hiding wiring, adhering to all government and manufacture standards.The whole process was very seamless and quite enjoyable and the crew made sure no mess or rubbish was to be spotted after they left.Would highly recommend PTE Solar & Electrical to anyone looking to invest in Solar/Batteries, needing electrical maintenance and any other electrical related projects.
We ended up going with another installer, but Emily from PTE was knowledgeable, patient with all our requests and respectful of changes to our requirements.

PTE ticked all the boxes in quoting, communication, installation, service and value.Very professional, attention to detail, courteous and timely through out the entire process.Will highly recommend PTE to family and friends.

PTE Solar were very efficient and great value for money. From obtaining the quote to explaining the various options available and suitable to my home. They made the process very easy in assisting us to decide on the best system and inverter that would work for us. The owner was very patient in explaining the pros and cons of the various systems and was very honest with his recommendations which was highly appreciated.On the day of installation the team was very punctual and tidy, completing the Job in half a day.PTE solar made the process extremely simple and streamlined, they assisted with all the paperwork so that I had nothing to worry about including connection to the grid.I would highly recommend PTE Solar and have recommended them to my family, they were a pleasure to deal with and met all expectations.

Amazing amazing installer, pte solar is the place to go. The pricing firstly will leave you happy, but the tidiness is on point and further very punctual in the case that you will have a wider understanding of what the system you have gone with can provide you. Honestly best business with the work they provide and the people would suggest everyone to be using them.

Patrick and Emily provided a fantastic service from beginning to the end, they were very patient with our many questions. Patrick and the install team arrived on time and the install was completed in one day. After sale service was amazing- they dealt directly with our energy provider! Would highly recommend!

We are doing major renovations (inc. a pool) so thought about time to bite the bullet and get solar. I contacted 4 companies, and whilst I awaited on-site meetings consulted Google to arm myself with knowledge (very easy to go down the internet rabbit-hole and get hundreds of opinions, until you head is swimming!). Anyway, I at least had enough knowledge to ask some sensible questions of the suppliers / installers.I discovered there are at least 2 kinds of Solar Panel suppliers;1. BIG CORPORATES who use sales reps, - very friendly but they have never held a tool or personally installed a panel in their lives (probably selling fridges at HN before this). One large national company doesn't even do a site visit! They use a call centre, assessed over the phone, they use Google maps and street view to review and and decide best solution for you!You would have to be crazy to spend this much money (I was looking at $10K+) and base it on a call centre guy with no direct experience installing panels! I asked some basic questions, and I could tell they were just reading answers from a script.2. SMALLER OPERATORS, where the guy you are talking to has been on roofs and installed thousands of panels. They know what is involved and what is possible.The uniqueness of our installation (an old warehouse converted to a home) required some lateral thinking. Patrick at PTE Solar was more than happy to explore options (eg. rotating orientation of panels to maximise roof coverage) and also use a large slightly SW facing roof for panels. Two other companies who quoted (via sales reps) both said NO, using SW roof would not work. and panels would be wasted and useless. They were just giving textbook answers. Patrick took the time to look at it more closely, correctly assessed that the shallow roof angle would work, and installed panels on that roof. I am thrilled to now see that panels on that section of roof are generating approx 45% of our power, mostly from noon till dusk!The installation was on-time, professional and thorough. I'd be happy to recommend Patrick, Kiran and PTE solar to any of my friends.John (Alexandria NSW)
